caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot positioned centrally on a plain background. The teapot is rendered primarily in brown, with subtle shades of red, yellow, and orange giving depth and highlighting contours. The teapot features a high, rounded lid with a decorative knob on top, a curved spout extending to the left, and an arched handle curving to the right. The use of shading suggests a metallic surface, with darker tones present on the left side and underneath the spout, as well as beneath the body, indicating shadow and light source from the upper right. The background of the drawing is a plain, unadorned light beige, and the artist's signature is located in the bottom right corner.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
